info.title: ECO-TOO Contact API
info.description: Contact form submission for ECO-TOO. Requires user consent and a valid Cloudflare Turnstile token for the contact or callback action. Not an unrestricted automated messaging API.

post.description: Sends an enquiry by email. Use the website contact form to obtain a Turnstile token; do not bypass anti-spam protection. Only POST is supported; other methods return 405 with Allow: POST.

200.description: Submission accepted. Anti-spam honeypot submissions also receive this response without sending email.

400.description: Invalid form: bad_request, missing_fields, bad_email, bad_phone or captcha_required.

403.description: Turnstile verification rejected: captcha_failed_<reason> (invalid_<Cloudflare error codes> or action).

500.description: Server configuration missing: captcha_not_configured or not_configured.

502.description: Upstream service failure: captcha_unavailable or send_failed.

ContactForm.description: Text fields are trimmed and truncated to 2000 characters by the server.

consent.description: Non-empty value confirming the user's consent to processing the enquiry, for example on.

captchaToken.description: Cloudflare Turnstile token for action contact (or callback when type=callback). Not truncated by the server.

floorInstallation.description: Non-empty value indicates interest in floor installation.

floorDataTransfer.description: Non-empty value indicates separate, optional consent to share contact details with the floor installation contractor.

website.description: Anti-spam honeypot. Leave empty or omit.

type.description: Optional. callback = short callback request from the home page calculator: only phone (at least 9 digits), consent and a Turnstile token for action callback are required.

estimate.description: Estimated installation cost shown to the user (callback requests).

error.description: One of: bad_request, missing_fields, bad_email, bad_phone, captcha_required, captcha_failed_<reason>, captcha_not_configured, not_configured, captcha_unavailable, send_failed.
